rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.requirement: Bill reported favorably by the Joint Committee on Housing that would prohibit algorithmic rent setting in Massachusetts. The chunk gives no operative text, so definitions, prohibited conduct and penalties are not stated.
rules.status_basis: Reported favorably by committee on 3/12/2026 and referred to Senate Committee on Ways and Means; no passage shown. It is a new draft of S994 and S1016.
rules.quoted_span: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
